title: A WSN Instance with Strong Linear-Cryptanalysis Arguments
summary: The bison WSN instance has strong differential resistance but only normal linear-resistance arguments; find a similar WSN instance with comparably strong linear-security arguments.

formal_statement.body: The bison instance of the Whitened Swap-Or-Not (WSN) construction has strong resistance to differential cryptanalysis, but its available resistance arguments for linear cryptanalysis are only normal. Find a similar WSN instance whose resistance to linear cryptanalysis admits security arguments comparably strong to those available for differential cryptanalysis.

scope.domain: Symmetric block-cipher design using the Whitened Swap-Or-Not (WSN) construction, with resistance evaluated against differential and linear cryptanalysis.
parameters: WSN instance: the construction instance whose linear-cryptanalysis resistance is sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Find a similar WSN instance for which resistance to linear cryptanalysis admits security arguments comparably strong to those available for differential cryptanalysis.

citations.label: bison Instantiating the Whitened Swap-Or-Not Construction

progress.summary: The authors present bison as a WSN instance with strong resistance to differential cryptanalysis, while stating that their arguments for linear cryptanalysis are only normal. They pose finding a similar instance with comparably strong linear-security arguments as an interesting question.
citation_labels: Anne Canteaut et al., bison Instantiating the Whitened Swap-Or-Not Construction
